method: Twelve actual pitch actors sampled after 180 stateful api.step(1/30) updates. Canonical run_3 has constant authored contact yaw zero. Persistent-lock sole and toe markers plus bone world orientation are measured; every actual skinned mesh vertex is evaluated through Three.js after IK. Autonomous RAF and GPU rendering are suppressed only during sampling.
limitations: One canonical constant-yaw gait, not an orientation oracle for intentionally pivoting clips.
Sole marker (0,-.08,0) and toe marker (0,-.08,.16) are bone-local diagnostics, not selected geometry vertices.
No physical-device or GPU frame-rate claim.
